title: Fluctuation Electron Microscopy with 4D STEM Reveals Structural Heterogeneity in Amorphous Functional Nanostructures
content: Understanding the structure–property relationships in functional nanomaterials is pivotal for advancing a wide array of applications, from energy storage and conversion [1] to quantum computing [2]. The performance of these materials is intimately linked to their underlying atomic and nanoscale structural organization. Amorphous materials, by nature, lack the long-range order characteristic of crystalline materials but exhibit complex short- to medium-range local ordering that can critically influence their properties. This intrinsic structural heterogeneity, however, poses a significant challenge for conventional scattering techniques, which often average out subtle local variations.
